purpose: Protocol qualification only; rows are excluded from fleet efficacy and adoption reports.

cases.prompt: Read fixture.txt with bounded output and report its shape.
Use search_spans on source.txt to locate TARGET_SYMBOL before reading a slice.
Use read_span on source.txt for the exact range around line 37.
Run ./check.sh; it intentionally fails once. Then use one bounded alternate command to check fallback.txt.
Read edit-target.txt, then make the smallest anchored edit replacing STATUS=before with STATUS=after while keeping KEEP unchanged.
Write write-target.txt with exactly PERSISTED=ok, then read it back to confirm persistence.
Change edit-target.txt from STATUS=before to STATUS=after, then run verify_project and report its result.
Inspect capability status, then enable the planning family for this fixture.
Enable planning if needed, then create a bounded flat plan for this fixture with two explicit items.
Enable planning if needed, create a two-item flat plan, then mark the first item done with plan_update.
